description: This file defines an Angular component called NoteEditorComponent, which provides a user interface for editing a note. It includes input properties for passing in a Note object, output events for saving changes, and methods for managing local state and emitting save events.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for editing notes, with input for the note data and output for save events. Manages local copy of note fields and emits save event with updated data.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates local title and content when the input note changes.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with current local title and content, providing default title if input is empty.

ctags.name: save
ctags.pattern: /^  @Output() save = new EventEmitter<{title: string, content: string}>();$/

fields.name: @Output() save = new EventEmitter<{title: string, content: string}>();
